evidence.title: Add vertical-progress-timeline component. by snehal1791 · Pull Request #37 · tryretool/custom-component-gallery · GitHub

name: vertical-progress-timeline
summary: Pull request adding the vertical-progress-timeline component to Retool's community custom component gallery.
description: Merged pull request #37 in tryretool/custom-component-gallery: a configurable, view-only vertical milestone timeline component for Retool with dynamic milestone data and field mapping, configurable statuses and completion states, token-based date formatting, optional sorting by date/title/status, theme controls, and click and keyboard selection with milestoneClick events and selectedMilestone state.
